description: This file defines the APIRecipesRepository class, which provides methods to fetch recipe data from a backend API, including listing all recipes and retrieving a specific recipe by ID. It uses fetch API calls and constructs URLs based on a base URL provided at instantiation.

classes.name: APIRecipesRepository
classes.description: A class that provides methods to interact with a recipes backend API, including fetching all recipes and fetching a specific recipe by ID.

methods.name: constructor(baseUrl)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a base URL for API requests.

methods.name: list()
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of all recipes from the API endpoint '/recipes'.

methods.name: getById(id)
methods.description: Fetches and returns a specific recipe by its ID from the API endpoint '/recipes/:id'.
